rules.title: Prohibition of Housing Discrimination Based on Source of Income and Protected Classes
rules.requirement: Landlords are prohibited from discriminating against tenants or purchasers in the sale or rental of housing based on race, creed, color, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, marital status, civil union status, ancestry, actual or perceived physical or mental disability, nationality, affectional or sexual orientation, familial status, domestic partner status, or the source of lawful income or source of lawful rent or mortgage payment.

coverage.summary: Applies to the sale or rental of all property including open land, whether for business or residential purposes, with specific exceptions for owner-occupied two-family dwellings and one-family dwellings.
coverage.owner_condition: Exempts the rental of a single apartment or flat in a two-family dwelling where the other unit is owner-occupied, and the rental of rooms in an owner-occupied one-family dwelling.

rules.exemptions: Rental of a single apartment in a two-family dwelling occupied by the owner; rental of a room in an owner-occupied one-family dwelling; religious preference by a religious organization; housing for older persons regarding familial status.
rules.quoted_span: The NJ Law Against Discrimination (LAD) prohibits discrimination on the bases of race, creed (religion), color, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, marital status, civil union status, ancestry, actual or perceived physical or mental disability, nationality, affectional or sexual orientation, familial status, and domestic partner status.
